card.fact_statement: Labour Minister Yolanda Díaz introduced paid climate leave in response to the 2024 Spanish floods.
card.source_span: Labour Minister Yolanda Díaz introduced a new system of "paid climate leave", which would allow workers to stay at home for up to four days during weather emergencies.

target_qa_variants.question: Waziri wa Kazi Yolanda Díaz alianzisha mfumo gani mpya kufuatia mafuriko ya Uhispania ya 2024?
target_qa_variants.source_span: Labour Minister Yolanda Díaz introduced a new system of "paid climate leave", which would allow workers to stay at home for up to four days during weather emergencies.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'paid climate leave' to 'likizo ya tabianchi inayolipwa' (paid climate/weather leave).

backtranslation_en.question: What new system did Minister of Labor Yolanda Díaz introduce following the 2024 Spain floods?
